say: Now, let's see how to buy something safely on Stall.
Tap the search bar, and type what you need. Results from people near you show up straight away.
Tap an item to see the details. Check the price, the seller, and their reviews. A verified badge means Stall has checked they're a real student. When you're happy, tap Add to bag.
In your bag, read and tick the box, then tap Continue.
Choose pick up or delivery, then tap Pay securely. You can pay by card, bank transfer, or USSD.
Once you've paid, you'll get a release code. Stall holds your money safely, until the item is in your hands.
When you meet the seller, check the item first. If it's right, give them the code. That's when they get paid, and your order is complete.
Simple, and safe for everyone. No more stalling. Stall it.
